messages:
noah: Weird UX report from support: console p50 trend looks better than endpoint p50 for /api/chat. Users confused why rollup 'improves' on certain days.

emma: Could be provenance differences again. Are we showing merged rollups by default with no hint about contributing sources? Support often screenshots the summary tiles and misses endpoint detail.

jamal: Quick reality check: rollup for 2026-04-02 shows p50=90ms, but endpoint raw p50=130ms for same hour. I queried rollup.meta and saw rollup.quantile_method=GK and rollup.sample_breakdown contains internal:400, external:20k.

product-zi: From product POV we need a clear affordance: a "Provenance" toggle on the latency tiles that controls whether rollup aggregates include internal/debug sources. Defaults: exclude internal for SLO contexts, include for full system view.

noah: Also want a compact provenance pill: "external 20k | internal 400" next to p50. Click = expand details.

emma: Implementation idea: server emits rollup.meta.provenance_counts map and rollup.meta.quantile_method. UI renders pill and a small chevron to expand. If internal_count > 0 and user is viewing an SLO dashboard, default to hiding internals and show a yellow banner: "Internal traffic excluded(click to show)".

jamal: Telemetry caveat: provenance_counts increases cardinality a bit but it's just a tiny map of known sources (internal, canary, synthetic, external). Storage delta negligible; ingestion change trivial. Biggest cost is exposing it across many historical points in UI (bandwidth), but we can paginate/only fetch detail on hover.

oncall-jen: Ops note: when we flip default exclusion, we should ensure alerts that run on rollup metrics are not silently affected. Our alerting infra reads from endpoint-exact for SLOs but some ad-hoc alerts read rollups. We'll need a migration plan.

product-zi: We'll add a feature-flagged rollout: 1) surface provenance pill; 2) default exclude internal for SLO view; 3) add a small explain copy. If rollout looks good, flip for everyone.

noah: SQL snippet I used to confirm the split:
```sql
SELECT hour, rollup.p50, endpoint.p50, rollup.meta.provenance_counts
FROM latency_rollups rollup
LEFT JOIN latency_endpoints endpoint USING(route,hour)
WHERE route='/api/chat' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-04-02T09:00' AND '2026-04-02T11:00';
```

jamal: I'll add provenance_counts at ingestion and keep it as a compact array of pairs to avoid schema churn. Also will add rollup.meta.prefer_endpoint_hint boolean when endpoint data available (helps UI decide default).

emma: For UX, please make the pill clickable and add the tiny action "Prefer endpoint" so users can switch tile to show endpoint values in-place (no page reload). That should reduce support tickets.

product-zi: Good. Add short tooltip text: "Provenance: breakdown of sample origins. Showing external-only values for SLO context by default." We'll own the copy and UX tests.

oncall-jen: I'll schedule a canary deploy for the ingestion change. Also adding runbook entry: if users report p50 mismatch, check provenance_counts and prefer_endpoint_hint.

deploy-bot: :warning: deploy scheduled 2026-04-05T02:30Z rollout: add-rollup-provenance-pill (id: aggr-5012)

noah: Thanks folks. Once feature-flagged UI is up, can we run a quick audit to find top 50 routes with >5% p50 divergence between rollup (external-only) and endpoint? That will help prioritize exact quantile for SLOs.

jamal: Yep will add audit job after ingestion PR merges.

-- end of thread --
